description: U.S. domestic airline route network. Activities represent hub-and-spoke or point-to-point route markets. Epistasis blocks: {ATL,ORD,DFW,LAX} hub cluster, {SFO,JFK,MIA,SEA} coastal/international cluster, {DEN,BOS,PHX,MSP} regional cluster.
learning_objectives: Understand hub-and-spoke vs. point-to-point strategy trade-offs
Observe how competitive overlap (K_AA) emerges from route similarity
Experience the cost of over-diversification (scope costs)
See how epistasis (route complementarities) creates natural strategic groups
